## Purpose and entry points
AutoGen is a maintenance-mode, multi-language framework for building autonomous or human-assisted multi-agent AI applications. The primary product is a Python package ecosystem; .NET provides both earlier chat-oriented libraries and a lower-level distributed agent runtime. Main user entry points are Python imports from `python/packages/autogen-core/src/autogen_core/__init__.py`, `python/packages/autogen-agentchat/src/autogen_agentchat/__init__.py`, and `python/packages/autogen-ext/src/autogen_ext/__init__.py`; Studio exposes a CLI and web server through `python/packages/autogen-studio/autogenstudio/cli.py` and `python/packages/autogen-studio/autogenstudio/web/app.py`.

## Python Core: event-driven agent runtime
`autogen-core` defines the low-level contracts for agent identity, lifecycle, messages, topics, subscriptions, serialization, cancellation, and component configuration. Applications register agents and subscriptions with an in-process runtime, then send direct messages or publish topic messages; the runtime resolves recipients and invokes handlers. Key paths: `python/packages/autogen-core/src/autogen_core/_agent_runtime.py`, `python/packages/autogen-core/src/autogen_core/_single_threaded_agent_runtime.py`, `python/packages/autogen-core/src/autogen_core/_routed_agent.py`.

Core also owns model-client/tool abstractions and context/memory boundaries rather than a provider implementation. `ModelContext` controls conversation history/token scope; tools/workbenches expose callable capabilities to agents. Paths: `python/packages/autogen-core/src/autogen_core/models/_model_client.py`, `python/packages/autogen-core/src/autogen_core/tools/_workbench.py`, `python/packages/autogen-core/src/autogen_core/model_context/_chat_completion_context.py`.

## AgentChat: opinionated application layer
`autogen-agentchat` builds user-facing conversational agents and teams atop Core. `AssistantAgent` drives model inference, tool calls, streaming, and task execution; user/code-executor/society-of-mind agents provide specialized interaction roles. Messages, task results, handoffs, termination conditions, and persisted state are AgentChat-level control data. Paths: `python/packages/autogen-agentchat/src/autogen_agentchat/agents/_assistant_agent.py`, `python/packages/autogen-agentchat/src/autogen_agentchat/messages.py`, `python/packages/autogen-agentchat/src/autogen_agentchat/base/_team.py`.

Teams coordinate turns and stop conditions. Group-chat implementations support round-robin, selector, swarm, sequential routing, graph-directed flow, and Magentic-One orchestration. A task enters a team, agent containers route messages/turns, and the team emits streamed events until termination. Paths: `python/packages/autogen-agentchat/src/autogen_agentchat/teams/_group_chat/_base_group_chat.py`, `python/packages/autogen-agentchat/src/autogen_agentchat/teams/_group_chat/_graph/_digraph_group_chat.py`, `python/packages/autogen-agentchat/src/autogen_agentchat/teams/_group_chat/_magentic_one/_magentic_one_orchestrator.py`.

## Extensions and external boundaries
`autogen-ext` supplies implementations behind Core interfaces: model clients for OpenAI/Azure, Anthropic, Ollama, llama.cpp, Semantic Kernel, and replay/cache; it isolates provider-specific message transformations and credentials. Paths: `python/packages/autogen-ext/src/autogen_ext/models/openai/_openai_client.py`, `python/packages/autogen-ext/src/autogen_ext/models/anthropic/_anthropic_client.py`, `python/packages/autogen-ext/src/autogen_ext/models/azure/_azure_ai_client.py`.

Extensions also bridge agents to unsafe or external capabilities: Docker/Jupyter/Azure code execution, browser automation via Playwright, MCP servers over stdio/SSE/HTTP, HTTP tools, Redis/Chroma/Mem0 memory, and Azure AI Search/GraphRAG. These are explicit trust and deployment boundaries. Paths: `python/packages/autogen-ext/src/autogen_ext/tools/mcp/_workbench.py`, `python/packages/autogen-ext/src/autogen_ext/code_executors/docker/_docker_code_executor.py`, `python/packages/autogen-ext/src/autogen_ext/runtimes/grpc/_worker_runtime.py`.

## Distributed and cross-language runtime
The shared worker protocol defines CloudEvent- and gRPC-based cross-process communication. Python worker hosts expose Core agents to a gateway; .NET implements corresponding contracts, local runtime, gRPC router, and an Orleans-backed registry/message gateway. Paths: `protos/agent_worker.proto`, `dotnet/src/Microsoft.AutoGen/Core.Grpc/GrpcAgentRuntime.cs`, `dotnet/src/Microsoft.AutoGen/RuntimeGateway.Grpc/Services/Grpc/GrpcGatewayService.cs`.

The .NET runtime’s central flow is `IAgentRuntime` → agent proxy/identity → subscriptions and handler dispatch, with in-process and gRPC implementations. Paths: `dotnet/src/Microsoft.AutoGen/Contracts/IAgentRuntime.cs`, `dotnet/src/Microsoft.AutoGen/Core/InProcessRuntime.cs`, `dotnet/src/Microsoft.AutoGen/Contracts/TopicId.cs`.

## .NET AgentChat and provider stack
A separate .NET library family offers chat agents, messages, middleware, group chats, and orchestrators, with adapters for OpenAI, Azure AI Inference, Anthropic, Gemini, Mistral, Ollama, and Semantic Kernel. It is organized around pluggable agent/provider implementations rather than the distributed Core runtime. Paths: `dotnet/src/AutoGen.Core/Agent/IAgent.cs`, `dotnet/src/AutoGen.Core/GroupChat/GroupChat.cs`, `dotnet/src/AutoGen.OpenAI/Agent/OpenAIChatAgent.cs`.

## Developer products and infrastructure
AutoGen Studio is a prototype-oriented no-code application: a Gatsby/TypeScript frontend calls a Python backend that persists components, teams, sessions, runs, evaluations, and gallery data, with REST/WebSocket and MCP integration. Paths: `python/packages/autogen-studio/autogenstudio/teammanager/teammanager.py`, `python/packages/autogen-studio/autogenstudio/web/routes/runs.py`, `python/packages/autogen-studio/frontend/src/components/views/teambuilder/builder/builder.tsx`.

AGBench is the evaluation CLI for benchmark templates, containerized scenario execution, log processing, and tabulation. Paths: `python/packages/agbench/src/agbench/cli.py`, `python/packages/agbench/src/agbench/run_cmd.py`, `python/packages/agbench/src/agbench/res/Dockerfile`. CI spans GitHub Actions and Azure Pipelines; local development supports Docker/devcontainers.
